name: ui-profiler
description: WinUI Profiler Agentic Development Environment (ADE). Does any kind of engineering work in a copy of your repository: bug fixes, features, changes, research and team work types, alone or in a personal workstream. You approve a proposal before any change. A shared Microsoft Agent Framework loop runs the coding agent, runs your checks and writes a report, a diff and a provenance record. Start with /ui-profiler:work.
